title: Apple’s China AI strategy now includes training its own custom model, per report - 9to5Mac
summary: Apple is reportedly taking a new route to bring artificial intelligence features to customers in China: training a large language model of its own with help from Alibaba. More recently, China’s internet regulator registered Apple Intelligence for use on iPhones.
